name: AI Launch Space
conditions: Free Standard listing requires adding the AI Launch Space badge to your site; it is verified automatically and only then does your listing carry a dofollow backlink.
Free listings go through admin review of 24–48 hours before appearing in the directory.
requirements: Legitimate, digitally delivered products only: SaaS, web/mobile apps, AI tools, developer tools, no-code/low-code platforms and templates, productivity/marketing/design/business software.
Must be a working, publicly accessible product — no placeholder, teaser, waitlist, or 'coming soon' pages.
Must be owned by you or submitted with the owner's authorization; accurate info and a functioning website.

Prohibited: adult/NSFW (incl. AI companions), deepfakes/impersonation, IP-infringement & piracy (watermark removers, AI-detection evaders), fake engagement/spam/scraping tools, gambling/chance mechanics, crypto & unlicensed financial products, regulated health/pharma/wellness, physical goods & manual services (freelancing/agency), illegal or harmful products.
preparation: Working public product URL — waitlist/coming-soon pages are rejected.
Badge embed ready on your site if taking the free route (verified automatically).
Project name, tagline, description, category, pricing model (Free/Freemium/Paid shown on listings).
Plan choice: Standard free (badge, 24–48h review) / Premium $4.99 per launch (no badge, featured, priority) / Sponsor $29/mo / Promote ads from $9/mo.
workflow: Go to https://ailaunch.space/submit (Submit Project in nav/footer) — a client-side form on the DirectoryLaunch boilerplate.
Fill project details and submit for review.
Free tier: install the badge so automated verification passes; admin review takes 24–48h.
If rejected, they email the reason and you may fix and resubmit.
Premium $4.99/launch skips the queue, drops the badge requirement, and adds featured placement plus newsletter featuring.
watchFor: Strict content policy mirrors payment-provider acceptable-use — borderline categories (AI companions, trading signals, supplements, scrapers) will be rejected or later removed.
Approved listings can be removed later if they fall out of compliance.
Free listing's dofollow link exists only while the badge is verified.
Submit page body did not render to a plain fetch (JS form) — expect a browser-driven form.
Directory is run by a solo operator ('Made by Alex Osso') and cross-links a family of sister sites.
countsAsLive: The project has a public page at ailaunch.space/project/<slug> appearing in the Browse/Latest Projects grid.
unknowns: Whether an account is required to submit.
Whether badge reverification is periodic and what happens on removal (delisting vs nofollow).
